3.1.0.en:
Migrated the build script (`tasks.js` => `tasks.mts`) to TypeScript
Migrated blockly to TypeScript
Fixed Office365: emails sent from scripts or other adapters failed after the first email, because the access token was not refreshed (#653)
A selected service has now priority over the stored host and port
Fixed the translations of the settings dialog and added Ukrainian to the Blockly block
The password is stored encrypted now and is not readable by other adapters. An existing password is encrypted automatically on the first start (#715)
Renamed the option "Ignore SSL certificate errors" to "Check SSL certificate", because that is what it actually does
Removed the unused dependency `googleapis`
